summary: A creative way to help generations to explore and learn about the abandoned but not forgotten that NASA had sent to the space.
details:
Project Details

Project Name: Abandoned but Not Forgotten

Project Category: Space Exploration, Astronomy, and Educational Technology

Project Description:

Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an interactive educational website developed as part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The project aims to create a comprehensive digital archive of space missions and spacecraft that traveled into space and never returned to Earth.

The website provides users with an engaging way to explore the history of space exploration, discover spacecraft and their destinations, understand their scientific achievements, and learn what happened to them after their missions ended.

Main Features:

  • Interactive Space Mission Archive: Explore space missions and spacecraft through organized and detailed information.
  • Mission Details: Discover each mission's objectives, launch date, destination, achievements, and final status.
  • Educational Quizzes: Test knowledge through interactive quizzes related to space missions.
  • User Accounts: Create accounts, log in, and track personal progress.
  • Progress and XP System: Earn experience points and unlock new learning levels.
  • AI Assistant: Get assistance and answers to questions about space exploration.
  • Interactive Dashboard: Access missions, learning activities, and personal progress in one place.
  • Multilingual Support: Make space knowledge accessible through English, Arabic, and French.
  • Question Rooms: Participate in interactive learning and discussions.

Project Goal:

Our main goal is to preserve the scientific and historical legacy of space missions by transforming complex space exploration data into an accessible, interactive, and enjoyable learning experience.

We want people to understand that even when a spacecraft stops communicating, disappears, or completes its mission far from Earth, its scientific contributions and discoveries should never be forgotten.

Target Audience:

Students, teachers, astronomy enthusiasts, space researchers, and anyone interested in space exploration and the history of humanity's journey beyond Earth.

Technologies Used:

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, AI integration, and web development technologies.

Expected Impact:

The project encourages scientific curiosity, improves access to space-related knowledge, promotes interactive learning, and helps preserve the history of humanity's space exploration achievements.
